sections.label: Prepare 512 wires
sections.description: Each Hadamard gives one wire a 50% chance of reading 1. The wires remain independent.

sections.label: Add phase
sections.description: Each ZPow adds 45 degrees of phase to its wire’s 1 amplitude. The wire probabilities stay at 50%.

sections.label: Undo phase
sections.description: Each inverse ZPow cancels the preceding rotation. To break the echo on one wire, remove the gate on q0 in this step.

sections.label: Read the echo
sections.description: All 512 wires return to 0. With the inverse rotation on q0 removed, q0 reads 1 about 14.64% of the time and every other wire still reads 0.
